text:
Full-Stack Developer with a cybersecurity focus at Sentinel Cybersecurity Solutions. Over the past four years, I’ve built scalable, secure systems that protect critical infrastructure. My work spans backend architectures, API design, and frontend tooling, always with an eye on mitigating risks and ensuring compliance.  

I specialize in microservices architectures, where I’ve led the migration of monolithic systems into modular, resilient platforms. PostgreSQL is my go-to for high-traffic applications, and I’ve optimized query performance to reduce latency by 40% in two production deployments. Python powers much of my automation and data analysis, while TypeScript ensures type safety in complex frontend and backend systems.  

Docker has been central to my CI/CD pipelines, enabling rapid deployment of secure containers. I’ve also worked extensively with Node.js to build real-time dashboards for threat monitoring. When I’m not coding, I’m refining REST APIs that balance speed and security, often integrating Redis for caching and rate limiting.  

Cybersecurity isn’t just a focus—it’s the foundation. Every line of code I write is audited for vulnerabilities, and I collaborate closely with DevOps and security teams to embed protection into the development lifecycle. Let’s build safer, smarter systems together.
